findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 2.1 1, 2.2 1, 2.3 3, 2.4 4, 2.5 3, 2.6 2, 2.7 1, 2.8 3, 2.9 2, 2.10 1.

Covers programming basics and the development environment, input/output with int() and float(), arithmetic and comparison operators, assignment and logical operators, operator precedence (worked trace), every decision form, nested conditionals, while and for loops with range(), functions with default, keyword and arbitrary arguments, libraries, the module search path and packages, lists, tuples with indexing and slicing, modules with the main function run from the command line, classes and objects with constructor and destructor, access modifiers and association, inheritance and polymorphism, exception handling with custom exceptions, file handling and file modes, testing (unittest) and debugging. None repeats the chapter exercise. Every program (including the multi-file module and package programs) was run in Python 3; the outputs shown are the real outputs. Book corrections followed (lower-case if and import, indentation, straight quotes, valid function names, BMI not used here).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
